metadata.description: Spec-driven code generation plugins for Augentic.

plugins.name: emery
plugins.description: Skills for the Emery workflow: `/emery:init` scaffolds a project, `/emery:plan` authors the change-level plan, `/emery:execute` drives the refine → build → merge loop to completion, `/emery:status` reports where the plan stands, and `/emery:finalize` closes the change.
